body.name: Certified outward-arithmetic handle \(H_n^{\mathrm{cert}}\)
body.construction: Starting move: for exact dyadic \((\widetilde X,\widetilde R,\widetilde C)\), adaptively double \(q_n\) in \(\mathbb F_n^{\mathrm{dir}}\); use the coordinate boxes of radius \(2^{-p_n-1}\) about the dyadic arrays to propagate observation-encoding uncertainty through residual-certified enclosures of the retained singular values, invariant subspace, pseudoinverse, matrix products, and exact-real endpoints. Use a three-way accept--reject--uncertain spectral gate; the uncertain branch returns the outward hull of \([-M_0,M_0]\) and the certified on-gate enclosure. Enclose \(\Phi^{-1}(q)\) and \(F_{\chi^2_{2r}}^{-1}(q)\) in polynomial time by rational interval evaluation of the error and regularized incomplete-gamma functions followed by certified interval bisection or Newton steps until width at most \(2^{-q_n}\). Record the propagated encoding radius as \(\Delta_n^{\mathrm{enc}}\), all SVD, gate, quantile, scalar-function, and endpoint-rounding radii as \(\Delta_n^{\mathrm{arith}}\), and return \(I_n^{\mathrm{dyad}}\) only with a containment certificate.
